resolved_validation_failures.cause: A keep-alive fixture admitted one empty request context while waiting for EOF.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: The final request explicitly closes the connection before receipt assertions.

resolved_validation_failures.cause: Artifact CLI overwrote CPU-grant and duplicate-grant diagnostics.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Candidate two preserves the original parser diagnostic and stops after duplicate admission failure.

resolved_validation_failures.cause: A coherent manifest and separate kernel replacement could select different embedded archive bytes.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Admission verifies named kernel data inside the digest-verified archive. The recorded overlay reproduced the defect without changing repository source.

resolved_validation_failures.cause: A stale test rejected all Metal LLVM emission.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: The test selects the unsupported Linux/Metal combination and verifies atomic output preservation.

resolved_validation_failures.cause: The Darwin HTTP receipt fixture required snprintf, absent from the separated software link inputs.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: The fixture uses distinct exit codes for each receipt assertion. Both target checks pass.

resolved_validation_failures.cause: The primary agent stopped CI to apply the HTTP fixture correction.
resolved_validation_failures.resolution: Final CI restarted after that correction.
